entities.name: Ivo Minář
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ivo Minář is a former professional male tennis player from the Czech Republic. On 20 July 2009 Minář reached his career-high singles ranking of World No. 62. His brother Jan is also a professional player, who has been ranked in the top 200 in the world.
